verified_facts.text: The hotel is mere steps from the historic Water Tower and Michigan Avenue.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mere steps from the historic Water Tower and iconic Michigan Avenue, Park Hyatt Chicago captures the essence of luxury hotel living in downtown Chicago.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is set in Chicago's historic Gold Coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in the historic Gold Coast, our luxury hotel places you moments from the best of downtown Chicago.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a three-lane lap pool on its 7th floor with views of the downtown Chicago cityscape.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our three-lane, 25-yard lap pool sits on the hotel’s 7th floor with views of the downtown Chicago cityscape.

verified_facts.text: There is no lifeguard on duty at the pool, and children 16 or younger must be accompanied by an adult.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note: No lifeguard on duty; children 16 or younger must be accompanied by an adult.

verified_facts.text: NoMI Kitchen serves modern American cuisine rooted in French techniques.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience modern American cuisine rooted in French techniques at our onsite restaurant, NoMI Kitchen.

verified_facts.text: NoMI Kitchen has an open kitchen with a Molteni stove, mid-century furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Michigan Avenue.
verified_facts.excerpt: an open kitchen boasting a Molteni stove, mid-century furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Michigan Avenue

verified_facts.text: NoMI Lounge has a six-seat Sushi Counter featuring fresh fish flown in from Japan.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests can experience an exclusive six-seat Sushi Counter featuring fresh fish flown in from Japan

verified_facts.text: NoMI Garden is an open-air rooftop terrace on the 7th floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: NoMI’s vibrant open-air rooftop terrace offers guests relaxed sophistication and a respite from the bustling city at its height on the 7th floor.

verified_facts.text: NoMI Garden is open during summer months.

verified_facts.text: Champagne Row is limited to six seats at a time.

verified_facts.excerpt: sweeping views of Lake Michigan and Chicago Avenue through expansive triple-pane windows, and spa-inspired bathrooms featuring dual vanities and lavish Le Labo® amenities

verified_facts.text: Select rooms include ergonomic Bryte beds.
